text_block_list.text:
During the practice race, Seeking the Pearl made a sudden leap sideways right after the start.
Perhaps because she had begun opening up to me—she finally revealed her reasons.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You can face all sorts of disadvantages during a race.
For example—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
'Drawing the widest gate,' 'missing the start,' 'getting knocked off course.'
Anything can happen. That is why—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I want to anticipate and test every single possibility.
So that I will never lose hope, no matter the situation.
...It seemed her sideways leap had been entirely intentional.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, I am a world-class pearl.
Yet I refuse to compete solely on the natural-born brilliance of my talent.
choice_data_list: Couldn't you win plenty on talent alone, though...?

text_block_list.text:
If it wasn't a temperamental issue, and her eccentric action had a logical purpose...
then Seeking the Pearl was a flawless, top-tier horsegirl.
It seemed she could easily rack up victories without being so cautious, but...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
True. Relying merely on talent, one might grow strong.
If all you aim for... is what that old woman once entrusted to me.

text_block_list.name: Tour Guide Old Woman
text_block_list.text:
Look here, little miss horsegirl.
This is the royal palace.

text_block_list.name: Tour Guide Old Woman
text_block_list.text:
Work hard so you can live in a place like this one day, all right?
I know you can do it.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: However, that story... had a continuation.

text_block_list.name: Young Pearl
text_block_list.text: Hey, Granny, do you live in a house like this right now?

text_block_list.name: Tour Guide Old Woman
text_block_list.text:
Heavens no... I just rent a tiny room in the back alleys.
That's how it goes in tourist towns.

text_block_list.name: Tour Guide Old Woman
text_block_list.text:
Dreams never come true for folks like us. That's why I want you to make the most
of your chance, little miss. Win enough for all of us, too.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
She entrusted her hopes to me... but the goal I formed was different.
It wasn't merely to succeed and live in a grand mansion.
choice_data_list: Then what is your goal, Seeking the Pearl...?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, isn't it obvious?
It is—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
To “banish the despair” of all the people across the globe
who cannot dare to dream, just like those I have seen with my own eyes!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't just that old woman. In the back alleys behind skyscrapers built
on oil money, countless people were struggling just to breathe.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Or those born in countries without industry, blessed with talent
yet never given the slightest chance to utilize it.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes, this world is a handicap race.
A cruel contest where the haves win and the have-nots lose.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And even those who have something will lose to those who have more.
Having everything decided by how you were born isn't fabulous in the least.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Even if you fall behind at the start, as long as you keep a challenging spirit,
you can catch up, you can turn the tide. I want to show them that hope.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The world is vast. So vast that words of encouragement cannot cross it. Yet, there is
one single thing capable of breaking through the language barrier. That is—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
—Racing. Simply running, competing, and striving for victory.
There is no nation on Earth unfamiliar with this primal sport.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
If the broadcast shows me overcoming every adversity to seize victory,
it will become a universal message for the entire world.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
My running shall unite the lands of the Earth as one!
Across the six continents! Across every island! Casting a rainbow of possibility!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
This is why I refuse to rely on talent alone.
This is why I dare to challenge the impossible. Understand?

For the first time, I understood the brilliance Seeking the Pearl was striving for.
It wasn't victory for herself alone—

It was giving hope to people all over the world. What made her world-class
was not merely her talent—it was the sheer magnitude of what she sought beyond victory.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Now then, I have shown you my world map.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Next, you must show me yours, Trainer!
What kind of dream do you envision for me?

What to aim for alongside Seeking the Pearl.
It wasn't simply reaching the pinnacle of the world.
choice_data_list: I want to show your possibilities—to the entire world!
I want to show your possibilities to the entire world!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: —Possibilities. You just said possibilities, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Good! No, that is perfect, Trainer!
In that case—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to demonstrate my present potential first.
Just to show you what I'm truly capable of right now.

And so came the rematch against Taiki Shuttle.
Turf, 1,200m, sunny, firm track.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ngggh, Pearl-san!? You're on a completely different level from before!?
This speed is...!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, magnificent, truly magnificent, Taiki...!
Running like that come rain or shine, you certainly are unbeatable at the mile. However!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
(The conditions are never set in stone. You never know what
might happen in this world. And out there in the world—)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
There is a Pearl capable of turning even yesterday's defeat into brand-new potential!
I've already committed your rhythm to memory! Hyaaaahhhhh!!
(Woooooaaaaahhh!!)

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey, she really is incredible, Seeking the Pearl!
I thought she might be a handful, but seeing her blow everyone away today...!

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I really should scout her.
I'm gonna go...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ho-ho-ho-ho♪ Beyond the limits of potential!
Beautifullll!!!!

text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text: H-Hey, where are you going!? Hey!

Having scored a sweeping victory, Seeking the Pearl vanished—
as if shaking off the trainers rushing to surround her.

—A short while later.
At the summer festival grounds.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, Trainer. Care for some accessories?
Fufufu...♪
choice_data_list: Found you at last... What are you doing?
Found you at last... What are you doing?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Running an accessories stall, of course. My daddy is a precious metals merchant.
Introducing exquisite jewelry to the world is the family business, after all.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's hear your order.
Which one will make your life truly sparkle:—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: This "Gold Pearl" or this "Silver Pearl"?

I glance down at the accessories displayed on the table, but...
My answer—is already decided, of course.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, good! Nice shopping!
Then let's make our partnership official, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Tell me, right now you must be thinking:
"I've found the finest pearl of all."

It goes without saying. Hearing my response,
Seeking the Pearl offered a mischievous smile, and—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, but unfortunately, that's not quite right.
You're not the one who found the pearl. The one who did—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Is me. I am the one who found the pearl known as you.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The one and only pearl who can make me shine—
in this wide, wonderful world.
